message:
You know, the other day I found myself rummaging through my closet looking for my go-bag, only to discover it was still packed from our last camping trip—complete with half-eaten granola bars and a very expired first aid kit. I had this moment of sheer hilarity mixed with a twinge of panic as I thought about how unprepared I was for an actual emergency. It’s funny how life can throw us little reminders to stay ready, even when we think we’ve got it all together. 

So, I took a deep breath, cleared out the bag, and started fresh. Sometimes, it’s the little things that keep us grounded, like knowing where our essentials are. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
